source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of characteristics of threats (PDF 180).

blocks.text: Har khatra mukhtalif tareeqe se kaam karta hai. Spam pehchanna aasan hai kyunke yeh dheron ghair matloob ishtiharat aur ajeeb offers ke saath aata hai; spyware baghair wazeh alamat ke peeche chupke se chalta hai. Spam bechna ya dhoka dena chahta hai, spyware chupke se zaati maloomat jama karta, cookies browsing ki aadatein jama karti, phishing dhoke se tafseel nikalwati, aur pharming maloomat churane ke liye jaali sites par le jati hai.

blocks.prompt: Kaunsa khatra pehchanna sab se mushkil hai, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Spyware, kyunke yeh baghair wazeh alamat ke chupke se chalta hai, spam ke bar-aks jo khule aam aata hai.

items: Khatron ke tareeqe aur maqsad mukhtalif: spam zahir, spyware chhupa, cookies peecha, phishing dhoka, pharming rukh moorna.
